answer: Because the forge calculation reruns each epoch, the reef weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the pigment settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 23% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A tight ring of 22 clones therefore holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. That is 12 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
